At Valdez Tree Service LLC, we’ve been serving Bentonville and the Northwest Arkansas area since 1990 with professional, reliable tree care. With over 25 years of hands-on experience, we take pride in delivering safe, efficient, and high-quality services that keep your property looking its best. From tree removal and trimming to stump grinding and lot clearing, our team has the skills and equipment to handle projects of every size.

We built our reputation on hard work, integrity, and customer satisfaction. Whether you need routine maintenance to keep your trees healthy or expert removal to protect your home or business, we approach every job with the same dedication and attention to detail. When you choose Valdez Tree Service LLC, you’re choosing a company that cares about your property as much as you do.
